svg.title: The actual one-plugin presentation catalog
svg.desc: The codebytes-agent-skills catalog references ./plugins/document-tools relative to the repository root. That package contains release-note and csv-analysis plus optional Copilot-specific components. This diagram depicts the checked-in fixture, not imaginary additional plugins.
